title: Formal Alignment Axiom Violation Rates Across Fine-Tuning Methods

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If different alignment methods produce different levels of preference coherence, this directly informs which training methods are compatible with formal alignment frameworks. Practical guidance for choosing alignment training procedures.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running SFT, RLHF, and DPO on the same base model requires three separate training pipelines, each with different infrastructure requirements. RLHF in particular is demanding. Beginners would struggle to set up all three methods correctly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three training methods, 100 preference queries across three axiom types. Each training method is a separate project. Even if using existing fine-tuned models, designing and running the 100-query test suite for three axiom types is substantial work.
